text: The Project Manager, Waterfront Secretariat, City Planning, will give a presentation on the Next Phase of Waterfront Revitalization. In 2021, City Council directed staff to reflect on the two-decade history of waterfront revitalization and to report back with a renewed vision for a further phase of waterfront revitalization work. A core priority for the next phase is to advance truth, justice and reconciliation, including through Indigenous engagement. This presentation will provide an overview of the project and Indigenous engagement process.
The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee deferred consideration of the item until the June 13, 2022 meeting of the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee.
